title: I made a game where you build your own aircraft and fight each other!
author: dr-w0bbinat0rz
selftext:
I had an unfinished project about this, that I made a couple of years ago, but it was just too much work to finish it: creating models, coding, etc..

I gave the code and ideas to Astra, and about 2 resets later we had this!

It's really fun to play, and has multiplayer.

replies.author: ElioVibe
replies.body:
No lol. War Thunder absolutely doesn't have the same gameplay than Red Baron and even less than other flight sims.

Here's it's 100% War Thunder. Not 60 %

And War Thunder is way more advanced than Red Baron 

Creating the exact same gameplay than a famous game when you can't compete with them in optimization, marketing, and anything is a problem if you want people to play your game. Especially when anyone can create a game.

Respect not only existing games but also gamers time. They won't use their time playing a basic version of an already existing famous 10 years old game when the tools for making games are suddenly way more powerful than ever.
